title: Knowlify vs Superside: Video Ad Batches or a Subscription?
summary: Knowlify vs Superside for Meta video: finished AI ads from Knowlify or a design-led subscription from Superside. Compare minimums, scope and Meta rules.
body_markdown:
## Which other creative subscriptions belong on the list?


Several subscription and batch services have lower entry points than Superside.[CreatStrat](https://creatstrat.com/) prices by ads per week: $299 a month for 5 ads a week, $499 for 10 and $899 for 20, billed monthly with cancel anytime. Its formats include statics, carousels, mashups of footage you own, AI video and AI UGC, and it reads results from your connected Meta ad account. The page does not describe a revision policy or say whether a person reviews each ad.


[Vidful](https://vidful.co/) sells three monthly plans, starting at $3,495 for 60 videos, with AI UGC, AI animation and edits of existing footage. It says its plans are billed monthly with no contracts and unlimited revisions, and first creatives arrive by the end of week one.[Adguns](https://adguns.com/service/weekly-creatives/) describes a typical weekly batch of 10 to 30 concepts plus resizes, from €1,000 a month, with monthly review and no long-term lock-in. Media buying, landing pages and original video shoots are not included.


Compare these on the same weekly output, formats, revisions and rights, not on the entry price alone. Our[Superside alternatives guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/superside-alternatives) covers more options.


## What Meta rules apply to subscription batches?


Meta's[aspect ratio guidance](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/103816146375741) recommends 9:16 for full-screen vertical placements and 4:5 for Facebook Feed. A subscription that delivers a set number of concepts should also deliver both masters for each one.


Motion and animation need a preview step. Meta's[Advantage+ creative page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/meta-advantage-plus/creative) lists image animation among its AI enhancements and says some may be on by default and can be turned off at any time. If a design or motion partner delivers animated ads, preview each one and switch off any enhancement that alters it.


Meta's[Create to Convert studies](https://www.facebook.com/business/news/4-ways-to-turn-still-image-ads-into-video-ads) , published in 2018, found that adding light motion to still ads gave a positive outcome for 69% of brands across 49 studies. Those studies are from 2018, so use them as a reason to test motion, not as a benchmark for your account.


Ask Superside whether the $1,000 software fee sits inside the $15,000 minimum, how many variants come with each concept, and whether motion and video work draws from the same flexible budget as design.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for a steady supply of finished AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram, with about 25 finished ads a week and a person checking each one.
- Superside fits teams that want design, motion, video and AI work under a subscription that starts at a $15,000 monthly minimum on an annual term.
- Ask Superside whether its $1,000 monthly software fee sits inside the $15,000 minimum, since its pages do not say.
- If statics are a large part of the brief, a broader subscription may serve it better than a video-only service.
- Compare the same weekly output, formats, revisions and rights in both proposals before you commit.


## FAQ


### What is the best option for weekly Meta video ads?


Knowlify is our top pick for teams that want about 25 finished AI video ads a week for Facebook and Instagram, with optional Meta management. Superside is the better fit when the brief is wider than paid social video and needs a design or motion team. Match the scope to the job.


### Is Superside cheaper than Knowlify?


Superside publishes a minimum, so public pages do not support a direct price comparison. Ask Knowlify for a quote on the same weekly output, then compare it with Superside's total cost, including the software fee and the budget you must commit to.


### Does Superside run Meta campaigns?


Its pages do not say it runs media. Its ad creative page names Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn among its social platforms and covers static design, motion graphics and video production. It does not say Superside buys media or manages campaigns, so ask directly whether media buying is in scope.


### What happens to unused budget?


Superside's pricing page says unused flexible budget rolls over for up to three months. Ask how that rule applies to your subscription and what happens at renewal, and get the answer in writing.


### Can Knowlify make static ads?


Not at scale. Knowlify's scope is video: AI UGC, character animation and AI commercials. It does not make static banners at scale, so choose a static-capable provider if statics are a large part of your plan.
